title: Why Speed, Not Size, Will Define the Next War

thesis: The speakers argue that in the current geopolitical climate, winning conflicts depends on speed rather than size because government procurement processes are too slow to leverage new technologies effectively. They contend that the U.S. must accelerate the adoption and deployment of advanced technologies like autonomy and AI across the military to maintain its edge against adversaries like China who are rapidly advancing.
